The chat message frame

Lucas, 2026-11-13: can we remove Foundry's own background around our chat cards, and put the token's name, the time since the message and the trash bin inside our cards, so they are bigger and easier to read? Yes, two ways. The cards below are drawn by the system's own functions with its real stylesheets (system.css and the theme of v0.0.371), at the chat's width (about 316 px). Foundry's own box is drawn by hand and is approximate.

Notes

  • Both give the card the chat's full width (Foundry's box took about 14 px and a line of height for its header).
  • A is CSS only: li.chat-message:has(.twod12.chat) loses its box; Foundry's header is restyled as the card's top line. Nothing is added, moved or removed, so it is a style change. Messages that aren't ours (a plain roll, another module's) keep Foundry's box.
  • B moves elements (Foundry's header is hidden and its name, time and trash are drawn in our card by a renderChatMessageHTML hook); it adds the token's image. A whisper's and a blind roll's marks would move in too. One line per message saved.
  • A one-line message (a Guard line, a follow-up): in A the time and the trash sit at its right; in B the time sits at its right and the trash shows on hover.
  • My recommendation: B if you want the token's face on every card (it reads faster in a busy chat); A if the time and the trash can stay as Foundry draws them.
